subject: Chemistry

objectives.name: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures
Apply knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures
Analyse, interpret and evaluate scientific information, ideas and evidence

components.name: Paper 1
components.covers: Relevant physical chemistry topics, inorganic chemistry, and relevant practical skills
components.format: 105 marks of short and long answer questions

components.name: Paper 2
components.covers: Relevant physical chemistry topics, organic chemistry, and relevant practical skills
components.format: 105 marks of short and long answer questions

notes: Assessment objectives are set by Ofqual and are identical across every board's A-level Chemistry; only the weightings differ.
20% of the overall assessment contains mathematical skills at Level 2 or above.
At least 15% of the overall assessment covers practical work.
